plan.objective: Identify concrete taxonomy defects in download.py with exact line evidence

steps.description: Read download.py to capture exact line-numbered source for the download function.
steps.success_criterion: Line-numbered text of all 7 statements including the requests.get call and open/write block is captured

steps.description: Analyze the requests.get call in download_source_lines for missing_timeout and ssrf (unvalidated url passed directly to outbound request).
steps.success_criterion: Each of missing_timeout and ssrf is confirmed or rejected with the cited line of the requests.get call

steps.description: Analyze response handling in download_source_lines for unchecked_status (no raise_for_status/status_code check before writing response.content).
steps.success_criterion: unchecked_status is confirmed or rejected citing the line where response.content is written

steps.description: Analyze the destination file write in download_source_lines for path_traversal (unsanitized destination path) and resource_leak.
steps.success_criterion: path_traversal and resource_leak each confirmed or rejected citing the open(destination) line

steps.description: Merge request_call_findings, status_check_findings, and file_write_findings into a deduplicated final defect list using only frozen taxonomy categories with line evidence.
steps.success_criterion: Every reported entry has one taxonomy category plus a line number, with no style or speculative items

plan.completion_criterion: final_defect_report lists all confirmed taxonomy defects in download.py, each with exact category and line evidence

blocked_by: s1: read_code failed, no tool-verified source listing available; findings below rest solely on the inlined objective source

defects.rationale: requests.get(url) is called with no timeout, so the request can hang indefinitely.
Caller-supplied url is fetched directly with no scheme/host validation, allowing requests to internal addresses.
destination is passed unvalidated to open() in write mode, allowing writes outside the intended directory.
response.status_code / raise_for_status is never checked, so error page bodies are written as if successful content.
